audit.whatIsWrong: phases[].side was "Skill" on all seven rows while the packet chart and content win[] both read Hwei/Hwei/Neeko/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei.
audit.why: Hwei opens with a full ranged palette while Neeko has no combo and no clone leverage; level 3 is the single window where her Q-W-E out-damages the one ability he has ready; from level 4 his layered zoning takes the lane back; two items in his range and zoning out-scale her all-in.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3 and 6 to Hwei, row 2 to Neeko, rows 4-5 left Skill; every why rewritten to match its verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes claimed Luden's makes the package lethal and never acknowledged that Hwei's items out-range hers.
audit.why: content spikes[2] and spikes[3] both say the item stages move to parity and then to Hwei; level 3 is the only genuinely Neeko-favoured spike.
audit.corrected: Level 3 root-bloom is your only kill window; level 6 is even; his items then out-range yours.

audit.whatIsWrong: FABRICATED ABILITY NAME. The full layer tracked "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)" in eleven places — winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[1].t, report[3].t, report[5].t and report[9].t. No such ability exists. Hwei's crowd-control palette is Subject: Torment (E). breakdown.cooldowns also had no digit in it (defect item 3), and the shield flagged in missingInteractions was never mentioned.
audit.why: packet.enemyAbilities and the kit file agree: P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair. Riot's own text for E reads "crowd control abilities: Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw", which is exactly the palette the page was trying to describe. Cooldowns: Q 10/9/8/7/6, W 18/17.5/17/16.5/16 with a shield, E 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, R 120/100/80 at 1300 range. The passive completes when a SECOND damaging spell lands, so breaking the chain matters.
audit.corrected: Every instance replaced with Subject: Torment (E), with its real 12s rank-1 cooldown, plus Subject: Serenity's 18s shield named as the thing to force out before committing.
sources: packet.defects (never names any of Hwei's abilities)

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldowns field named a spell that does not exist and gave no numbers.
audit.why: Subject: Torment at 12s rank 1 is the punishable window: it carries all of his crowd control, so a spent palette is when Neeko's commit is safe.
audit.corrected: Numbers added for Subject: Torment, Subject: Serenity and Subject: Disaster.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed (defect item 2): dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, both under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Titles promised clone play and trade timing; the bodies explained something else.
audit.corrected: Both replaced with Hwei-grounded content matching their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer carries three more invented names: "E dashaway lantern" (Hwei has no dash in the kit), "EW (Stirring Lachesis)" (the W palette's third ability is Stirring Lights) and "QE (Devastating Fissure)" (the Q palette holds Devastating Fire and Molten Fissure, not a merged name).
audit.why: Riot's text lists the palette contents explicitly for Q, W and E, and no dash appears anywhere in Hwei's kit.
audit.corrected: spikes[0], spikes[1], spikes[2] and content mid rewritten to name the palettes Riot actually gives, without asserting which sub-ability carries the fear — the kit does not say.

notes: The largest defect in my slice: the full layer tracked an ability called "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)" in eleven fields. It does not exist — Hwei's crowd-control palette is Subject: Torment (E) — and packet.defects already flagged that the page never names a single real Hwei ability. All eleven replaced, including focus.text. The content layer carried three more inventions ("E dashaway lantern", "Stirring Lachesis", "Devastating Fissure") which are corrected in spikes[0..2] and mid. Deliberately NOT asserted: which sub-ability of Subject: Torment carries the fear — Riot's text names Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw but does not say what each does, so the rewrites refer to the palette. packet.suspectNames flags "Use Shapesplitter" in the content mid paragraph; that is a false positive — Shapesplitter is Neeko's own W.
